text:
maria_cs: Morning team — kicking off Aurelia Health onboarding. Quick goals: 1) integrate Redwood Dedicated; 2) hit <150ms 95p latency for pilot traffic; 3) enable analytics export to Snowflake by week 3. Stakeholders: @devon_se (SE), @leah_enable (Enablement), @tyler_prod (Product), @olivia_support (Support). Risk: they expect SOC2 exec by week 2. Can everyone confirm owners + earliest deliverable?

devon_se: I’ll own integration + model selection. ETA for first test deploy: EOD Wed. Need access to their VPC peering creds. @maria_cs can you confirm?

leah_enable: I’ll lead enablement + training. Suggest two 90-min sessions (admin + developer). Tentative dates in timeline below.

tyler_prod: I'll validate success criteria with PMs. Latency target sounds right for pilot. I'll also coordinate canary feedback.

olivia_support: I'll own post-go-live support triage + SLAs. Need handoff docs and runbook.

maria_cs: Awesome. Here's a simple timeline I sketched:

Week 0 (this week): kickoff, gather creds, security review start
Week 1: infra + peering, test deploy, enablement session 1 (admin)
Week 2: load testing, latency tuning, enablement session 2 (dev)
Week 3: analytics export, go/no-go review, soft launch
Week 4: SLA handover + 30d health check

Please reply with blockers and any date conflicts.

devon_se: Blocker: customer requires HSM KMS flow, need infra support from eng-infra. I'll ping eng-infra after this thread. Also need model weight size limit clarified — can someone from runtime chime in?

tyler_prod: I'll add runtime owner: @ivan_runtime (not in thread yet) — for now I'll note model must be <= 12B or quantized.

olivia_support: For runbook: can we get a simple runbook template? I can draft if no one objects.

leah_enable: I can prepare slides + hands-on lab. Can we set sessions Wed 10am and Fri 2pm? Prefer one in customer's timezone (PST). maria_cs: confirm with customer?

maria_cs: On it. I'll ask Aurelia to confirm Wed 10am PST. Also uploading initial creds to secure vault once they provide.

onboard-bot: New onboarding checklist item assigned: "VPC peering info" -> devon_se. Due: 3311300000 :information_source:

devon_se: Got it, I'll track. Also note: need to validate dedicated capacity sizing — propose reserve 2x expected QPS for pilot.

tyler_prod: Agree. I'll run expected QPS numbers with their PMs and share by Tue.

maria_cs: Last thing: feedback capture — propose we run a short survey after enablement session 2 and instrument a few prompt-level evaluation checks in Redwood Optimize. Thoughts?

leah_enable: +1. I’ll author a 5-question feedback form and attach to session materials.

olivia_support: Add a Slack channel for the customer. I'll create #aurelia_onboard once we have account prefix.

maria_cs: Perfect. Everyone thumbs up on owners and timeline? :thumbsup:

devon_se: :thumbsup:

leah_enable: :thumbsup:

tyler_prod: :thumbsup:

olivia_support: :thumbsup:

maria_cs: Closing notes — I'll DM follow-ups and update calendar invites. Thanks team.
